summary: Hosted service, sprint 1t: follow-ups from the staging re-walk. The worker now carries the local embedding model, so a hosted run judges requirement coverage as the desktop does instead of falling back to word matches. The web takes a job as an uploaded file, whose text is extracted and the file dropped, or as a page address the person approves; the page is fetched once, at extraction, over a connection held to the address that was checked. The coverage message groups places by section, run details no longer report missing evidence for covered requirements, and the shared review screen uses wide screens and fits phone widths.
knownLimitations: Staging only: production keeps its earlier images until the owner deploys this tag there. Staging runs behind the owner token, so sign-in, plans and credits, and record export and deletion are not exercised there until the identity provider is hosted. The cost of a complete cached run is still to measure (#1597).
